# Link

```ts
import { Link } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

A text link that navigates — to another page, a section, or an external resource. Links navigate; buttons perform actions: if clicking runs a command (save, delete, open a dialog), use Button instead, and never style a link to look like a button. Use inverse on colored fills such as banners and promos.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Type size, always Rookery New Medium: sm 12px (Figma link.12), md 14px (link.14.body), lg 16px (link.16). The icon matches the text size. |
| `inverse` | `boolean` | `false` | For links on a colored fill (banners, promos): text, icon and focus ring all use --color-text-icon-on-primary (Figma hellopc.link.inverse). Never place the standard link on a colored surface. |
| `external` | `boolean` | `false` | The link leaves the app — a browser, a new window, another app. Shows the trailing open-in-new icon, opens in a new tab (target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer") unless you pass your own target / rel, and announces "(opens in a new window)" to screen readers. |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Replaces the trailing icon (Figma icon swap). Inherits the link color and size — don't size or color it yourself. Shown whenever it is set. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the link inert: no href, aria-disabled="true", removed from the tab order, clicks ignored. Use sparingly — prefer hiding a destination that doesn't exist. |

Also accepts all `React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<Link href="/warranty">View warranty details</Link>
<Link href="/support" size="lg">Contact support</Link>
<Link href="https://lenovo.com/support" external>Lenovo support site</Link>
<Link href="/tips" icon={<ArrowRight />}>See all tips</Link>
<Link href="/offers" inverse>See offers</Link>
<Link disabled>Report unavailable</Link>
```

## Design tokens used

`--color-text-icon-link`, `--color-text-icon-disabled`, `--color-text-icon-on-primary`, `--font-family`, `--font-weight-medium`, `--type-size-caption`, `--type-size-body`, `--type-size-subject`, `--space-050`, `--stroke-300`, `--radius-50`

## Accessibility

- It's a native <a href>: Enter follows it and it's announced as a link. Write text that names the destination ("View warranty details", not "Click here") — screen-reader users often navigate by a list of links.
- The underline is never removed, so links don't rely on color alone (WCAG 1.4.1). The 24px minimum height meets the target size (WCAG 2.5.8).
- external adds visually hidden "(opens in a new window)" text, so the change of context isn't a surprise.
- disabled drops the href, sets aria-disabled="true" and leaves the tab order. Prefer removing a link that has nowhere to go.
- Focus is restyled (3px ring in the link color), never removed.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use a link to go somewhere | Use a link to run an action — that's Button |
| Mark links that leave the app with external | Open new windows without warning |
| Use inverse on colored fills | Put the standard link on a colored surface |
| Write descriptive link text | Write "Click here" or "Learn more" on its own |
